origin: devin-cli implementation-convergence audit 2026-09-24 (metadata-vs-article deadline divergence found after in-place normalization)

problem.summary: metadata.startup_complete_deadline_ms now reads 20000, but authoritative article A199 (per metadata.startup_authoritative_article = A484+A193+A199+A496) still fixes HARD-DEADLINE:10000ms inclusive with BUDGET-CARRY total-never-exceeds-10000ms, and maintenance_manual_directory.STARTUP_TEN_SECOND_DEADLINE still verifies 10000ms. The runtime resolves startup_complete_deadline_ms codex-first via codex_readonly_connection, so the effective enforced deadline is now 20000ms while the normative article still mandates 10000ms.
problem.codex_state: metadata.startup_complete_deadline_ms=20000 (changed during the 2026-09-24 in-place normalization; no governor_disposition_* key covers the deadline); articles.A199 rule text unchanged: HARD-DEADLINE:10000ms inclusive, BUDGET-CARRY total-never-exceeds-10000ms, per-phase budgets summing to 10000; maintenance_manual_directory.STARTUP_TEN_SECOND_DEADLINE verification='every measured cold warm reconnect and injected-failure startup completes within 10000ms' (introduced_version 3.21600, unchanged).
problem.impact: Runtime deadline (metadata-derived) diverges from the authoritative article; manifests synced to metadata (startup_manifest.json staged at 20000) now conflict with A199/TF_STARTUP_TEN_SECOND_DEADLINE evidence. Auditors cannot determine whether the deadline was intentionally relaxed or the metadata key drifted outside the amendment scope (the five-core normalization worker_note lists only A35/A205/A207/A208/A210/A212/A219/A343/A604 language-responsibility articles).

options.description: If the governor intended to relax the total deadline to 20000ms (e.g. to accommodate newly registered startup phases), amend A199 rule text (HARD-DEADLINE, BUDGET-CARRY, per-phase budgets), maintenance_manual_directory.STARTUP_TEN_SECOND_DEADLINE verification text, and any test_flow_codes references; keep metadata.startup_complete_deadline_ms=20000 and record a governor_disposition_startup_deadline key.

If A199 remains authoritative at 10000ms, restore metadata.startup_complete_deadline_ms to 10000 and revert startup_manifest.json governed_startup.startup_complete_deadline_ms to 10000; the in-place 20000 change then stands as an out-of-scope drift requiring remediation.
